steps.name: Professor Oak's Lab
steps.text: Professor Oak is offering you a Pokémon!

steps.name: Pokémon Center (Route 4)
steps.text: A shady salesman offers you a Magikarp…

steps.name: Mt. Moon
steps.text: Two fossils deep in the cave… which one do you take?

steps.name: Celadon Mansion
steps.text: A Poké Ball is lying on a table… it's an Eevee!

steps.name: Pokémon Tower
steps.text: The ghost of a mother Marowak blocks the top of the Tower!
steps.rewardText: Marowak's soul is at peace… Mr. Fuji entrusts you with her little one.

steps.name: Route 12
steps.text: A Snorlax is blocking the way!

steps.name: Rocket Hideout
steps.text: You get your hands on the Silph Scope: the Pokémon Tower's ghosts can't hide anymore!

steps.name: Fighting Dojo
steps.text: The Karate Master offers you one of his Pokémon!

steps.name: Victory Road
steps.text: Blue is waiting for you at the end of Victory Road: one last battle before the League!
